GOVERNMENT OF STATE
PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT (PWD)
OFFICE OF THE SUPERINTENDING ENGINEER, STATE HIGHWAY DIVISION

NOTICE INVITING TENDER (NIT)
NIT Ref: PWD/SH/2026/TND-441
Date: 01 October 2026

PROJECT: Widening and Strengthening of State Highway SH-12 (km 14.0 to km 38.5)

1. TENDER PARTICULARS:
- Estimated Project Cost: INR 18,50,00,000 (Eighteen Crores Fifty Lakhs Only)
- Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): INR 2,00,000 (Two Lakhs Only) by Bank Guarantee or Demand Draft.
- Tender Document Fee: INR 10,000 (Ten Thousand Only) Non-Refundable.
- Period of Completion: 18 Calendar Months.

2. PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA:
- Contractor must hold valid Class-1 Super Special Category registration.
- Minimum 5 years continuous experience in bituminous state or national highway road construction.
- Average annual financial turnover in the last three financial years must not be less than INR 5,00,00,000 (Five Crores Only).

3. KEY DATES & TIMELINES:
- Document Download Start: 03 October 2026, 11:00 IST
- Pre-Bid Meeting: 10 October 2026, 14:00 IST at PWD Conference Hall
- Bid Submission Deadline: 25 October 2026 up to 15:00 IST
- Technical Bid Opening: 26 October 2026, 11:00 IST

4. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS:
Bids must be submitted strictly through the State e-Procurement Portal (https://eproc.state.gov.in) with valid Class-3 Digital Signature Certificate.

Superintending Engineer, PWD State Highway Division
Email: se-shd@pwd.state.gov.in
